summary: a venn set is declared twice
rationale: Mermaid draws a second circle coincident with the first, both take the last label, so an earlier label never renders.

summary: a venn set or union size is zero or negative
help: Give the set a positive size.
rationale: A zero size erases the set and every intersection over it, and a negative size distorts the layout or throws out of it.

summary: venn diagram declares only one distinct set
help: Declare more sets, or use a different diagram kind.
rationale: A single circle has nothing to intersect, so the diagram carries no comparison.

summary: a venn union names the same set twice
help: Remove the duplicate set from the union list.
rationale: The list is never deduplicated, so the set is intersected with itself and draws a spurious region.

help: Add at least one set line.
rationale: Unlike the other no-data cases the renderer throws instead of drawing an empty frame, so the diagram fails outright.

summary: the same venn intersection is declared twice
rationale: The member lists are sorted but never deduplicated, so a reordered duplicate draws a second region over the first.
